title: Works great, BUT not the size I was expecting…
text:
Works great, BUT not the size I was expecting…. [[VIDEOID:88422af86e0d7678c4dd46c8111bca8d]] First, this bucket size is only .66 gallons. Not very large. This can handle 50 pints a day with. Direct hose hook-up OR you have a lot of emptying to do.

Nonetheless. I like this miniature dehumidifier. It has nice features and is good for SMALL rooms. Like I said, if you want to use this in a basement, only do so by using the drain hose option.

I have this 3 star review which is average. I would have give 5, if it was clear in the capacity size of this. It works great, but title can be very misleading.

Trust you found this review honest and helpful.

features: 【3,500 Sq Ft 50 Pint Dehumidifier】Our dehumidifier can effectively remove up to 50 pints (at 95°F/90%RH) of moisture per day and can reduce air humidity from 80% to 30%, which makes it easy for you to maintain a healthy humidity range at 45%-60%. The dehumidifiers are fit for medium to large rooms in areas up to 3500 Sq Ft and are perfect for use in the basement, home, bedroom, storage room, garage, bathroom, office, kitchen, laundry room, and RV.

【Ultra-Quiet & 3 Working Modes】Ultra-quiet design, less than 40 dB, or set a low fan speed when sleeping or at work. Our dehumidifiers for home have 3 modes: DEHU-keeps the ideal humidity level by customizing the humidity setting, can be used in wine cellars and storage rooms where there is a clear need for space humidity; DRY-quickly dry wet clothes and cotton household items and protect clothes from moisture; CONT-suitable for constantly damp spaces where continuous dehumidify is required.

【2 Ways to Drain】Manual Drain: The dehumidifier for bedroom features an intuitive front water tank design that allows you to see the water collected. When the 0.66-gallon bucket will full, the portable dehumidifier will auto-stop running and lights up the full water indicator to remind you to empty it; Continuous Drain: Our dehumidifier for basement comes with a 3.28 feet drain hose that you can easily connect to the outlet of the dehumidifier and the sewer system for continuous drainage.

【Ingenuity Appearance Design】It is designed with a top handle, embedded handrails on both sides and four 360° universal wheels to facilitate flat movement and up-and-down handling without scratching the floor. The front digital humidity display can be used as a hygrometer to detect real-time humidity, which allows you to control the room humidity at any time. The dehumidifier for bathroom supports preset power-on/off time, up to 24 hours, reducing energy consumption and bringing convenience.

【WARRANTY & SUPPORT】Wellsle 50 pint dehumidifier covers 30-day money back, a 12-month warranty, a 1-year warranty extension, and lifetime technical support. Choose our dehumidifier with drain hose, keep ideal air quality for your home. If any further questions, please feel free to contact us. We will provide 24-hour service for you.
